# Enchanting Recipes

<!-- This page is generated by tools/professions/build.py from tools/professions/recipes/enchanting.json. -->

:material-auto-fix:{ aria-hidden="true" } <span class="fc-meta__kind">Recipe list</span> <span class="fc-meta__date">Updated 10 November 2026</span> [Data and sources](#sources)

This page lists all 225 Enchanting recipes in the game client, build 1.60.1.70862. The headings are the headings of the in-game window. For the path from 1 to 300 and the recipe picks, see the [Enchanting guide](enchanting.md).

**Learn** is the skill that the client gives for the recipe. A dash shows a trainer recipe, because the client does not hold that skill. **Yellow** and **Grey** are the skills where the recipe changes colour. A **New** or **Changed** tag shows a recipe that is new or changed from Classic Era.
